m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What's that supposed to mean? In any regard, I just hope these Hoppers aren't savage meat eaters as the tales say.
If not for you, those brutes would have had my skin. I owe you a life-debt.
Can you guide us to the Solar Arc in the Valley of the Dark Sun?
These tracks certainly don't look like Mantis feet. Most likely Hopper sign. Let's follow them!
Fleshling... you caught! Soon you... become food!
Turn Shadow spawn, and face the Light!
I will die another day! Thank you Burrower and Burrow-Mouse-Friend.
These dark-sun-beasts baited their trap with fouled food, and were waiting to ambush me. Time to give ground!
My sister, Simone RandomWing, sent sign to expect you. Welcome, welcome, welcome.
The desert leads to the spiked jaws of the Atramental Gate of the Hive, but also spirals away into the deep desert.
Somewhere out there is the Valley of the Dark Sun and the Solar Arc. A Desert Hopper could guide you through that hostile land.
Hoppers often raid Camp Arrow Weed, an Umbra hold. Search there for Hopper sign. Perhaps you can think like a Mouse.
Search Camp Arrow Weed for Hopper sign and convince them to help you! Try to think like a Mouse!
